The human reading is in licenceHuman. The Commons Clause forbids redistributing 「the components themselves -- whether alone, in a bundle, or as a ported version」. Formae IS a component library a customer picks from and that we hand over, so their code may sit on our own marketing site and may NOT sit in the library we ship.
